acpAgent.preset.title: Preset
acpAgent.preset.description: Cursor Agent runs 'agent acp'. Claude Code runs 'npx @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp --yes'. Custom has no command of its own: it runs the fields below, falling back to Cursor's for any left blank, and shows no agent logo.

acpAgent.agentCommand.title: Agent command
acpAgent.agentCommand.description: Executable to launch as the ACP agent process. Leave blank to use the preset's command; a value here overrides it.

acpAgent.agentArguments.title: Agent arguments
acpAgent.agentArguments.description: Command-line arguments passed to the agent process. Leave blank to use the preset's arguments; a value here replaces them, so include the preset's own arguments when adding a flag.

acpAgent.enableIdeTools.title: Let the agent read Visual Studio's state
acpAgent.enableIdeTools.description: Gives the agent read-only tools for Visual Studio: the Output window panes (Build, Debug, Tests and others, except the VsAcp pane), the open and active documents with the caret and selection, the solution's configuration and startup project, and whether a build or the debugger is running. Output can contain secrets, such as tokens in package-manager output. Applies when an agent next starts a session; the agent must support HTTP MCP servers.

acpAgent.enableChatDevTools.title: Enable chat DevTools
acpAgent.enableChatDevTools.description: Right-clicking the chat panel shows 'Inspect' to open the WebView2 developer tools (after Visual Studio restarts). Disable in production.

acpAgent.enableFileLogging.title: Enable file logging
acpAgent.enableFileLogging.description: Writes the VsAcp log to %APPDATA%\VsAcp\logs (one file per day). The VsAcp pane in the Output window is always on. Takes effect immediately.

acpAgent.title: ACP Agent
acpAgent.description: Which ACP agent process Visual Studio launches for chat sessions. Changes apply to new chat tabs.
